scenario.premise: This concept highlights sonicdesk as the ultimate collaborative workspace for bands, emphasizing version control and precise feedback.

timedStoryboard.visualNotes: Energetic montage: Musicians (guitarist, drummer, vocalist) in various settings (home studio, rehearsal space) captured in dynamic, quick cuts. Focus on passion and collaboration.
timedStoryboard.narration: Every band knows the struggle. Keeping your music organised. Tracking changes. Giving feedback.

timedStoryboard.visualNotes: Seamless transition to a clean, dark sonicdesk UI mockup, showing a song project with multiple versions/takes. Highlight waveform pills and subtle lime accents moving to indicate different versions.
timedStoryboard.narration: sonicdesk offers version control for your music, ensuring every take, every idea, is saved and accessible.

timedStoryboard.visualNotes: Zoom in on a specific part of the sonicdesk UI, showing a comment bubble tied to a specific bar/section of a waveform.
timedStoryboard.narration: Leave precise comments on specific bars, so your bandmates know exactly what you mean.

timedStoryboard.visualNotes: Fast cut back to musicians nodding in agreement, then a final shot of the sonicdesk logo and offer.
timedStoryboard.onScreenCopy: FREE 1ST MONTH BAND-PLAN THIS MONTH. SIGN UP.
timedStoryboard.narration: Collaborate effortlessly. Get your free first month band-plan this month.

script.oneLine: This campaign promotes the Snippet feature: inside a song's mixer you select a 5–30 second part of the mix (presets 5/10/15/20/25/30 s or free drag), it snaps to section starts (Verse, Chorus, etc.), loops for listening, and exports as an audio file you can use to test the hook in Reels/TikTok before release.

imagery.style: Dark, minimalist UI with strong contrast for highlighted elements. Lifestyle shots are authentic and slightly moody.
imagery.treatment: Waveforms are drawn as pill shapes. UI elements are sharp-edged, reflecting a studio gear aesthetic. Live-action musicians are captured with shallow depth of field for intimacy.

treatment.motionCharacter: Purposeful, precise, and responsive. UI elements animate with a mechanical, confident feel. Live-action transitions are energetic but smooth.
transitions: Fast cuts for scene changes, digital wipe for UI elements. Specific `cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1)` easing for all motion as per brand kit.
Elements enter with a subtle pop or slide that aligns with the beat. Waveforms build and shrink in response to sound amplitude.
